preconditions: The operations specialist's bound provider snapshot has been sliced (Jira + Confluence sections present or explicitly empty)
Provider bindings and filters have been enforced at read time before the slice reaches triage

postconditions.description: Every duplicate finding cites the issue keys being compared
Every under-specified finding cites the issue key and the reasons
Every proposal carries a typed writeIntent (duplicate-link or needs-info comment) and traces to its source issue
No provider write executes without approval; no load-bearing claim is present without a source id

description: Triage briefing produced by the operations specialist over its bound Jira + Confluence snapshot: inventoried tickets, detected duplicates, under-specified issues, and approval-gated triage proposals.
